content:
The financial planning world is fast-moving, and keeping up with the demands of the profession can be overwhelming.

Between managing client portfolios, offering investment advice, and handling superannuation and retirement strategies, the to-do list for financial planners grows rapidly. That’s where a Financial Planning Virtual Assistant steps in.

A professional and  highly qualified Virtual Assistant can support and can go a long way to assist you in managing a wide range of time-consuming administrative tasks that waste your time, freeing you to focus on higher-value activities. However, finding the right one, especially in a specialised field, requires critical understanding of the competencies to excel in the complicated world of financial planning support.

What To Look For In a Financial Planning Virtual Assistant

1. Financial Industry Knowledge

Financial planning is far from a general administrative role. It requires a deep understanding of the financial industry. So, when hiring a virtual assistant for a financial advisor, look for someone who:

  • Has hands-on experience and can understand Australian Financial Planning concepts
  • Background and working knowledge of various Superannuation schemes, Retirement and pension planning
  • Has working skills and knowledge in handling various Insurance schemes
  • Work experience in the entering of data of various Financial Planning crms needed in various investment options
  • Skilled and knowledgeable in assisting in Compliance Regulatory requirements, etc. needed in supporting the Australian Financial Planning

A simple error in any of these areas can be costly, and you need a remote assistant who understands the weight of these concepts to support your operations. At Virtual Office Angels, we ensure that our assistants are well-versed in financial planning, with specific expertise in the Australian market. With years of supporting Australian Financial Planners, they are aware of what’s required and committed to keep you and your company compliant and running smoothly.

2. Strong Attention to Detail

Even the most minor oversight can lead to significant problems in financial planning. Your virtual assistant will likely handle tasks such as assisting in the preparation of reports, updating financial records, and entering sensitive data in your crms, making a sharp eye for detail absolutely essential.

You’ll need a meticulous remote professional who ensures every report and data is accurate. They should demonstrate a history and hands-on experience in handling financial data precisely and completing tasks, reviewed many times, without errors.

Virtual Office Angels thoroughly screen its virtual assistants to ensure they have the exceptional and hands-on organisational skills and attention to detail that financial planners need. These skills help keep operations and are critical in running the business smoothly.

3. Proficiency in Financial Software

Financial planning involves using specialised software for tasks such as client relationship management (CRM), portfolio analysis, and financial forecasting. When hiring a Financial Planning Virtual Assistant, ensure they are proficient in supporting and entering date in industry-specific software such as:

  • XPLAN
  • Midwinter
  • Coin
  • AdviserLogic

Proficiency in these tools will streamline your operations and improve the efficiency of your practice, making your business grow faster. Your virtual assistant should also be comfortable with general office software like Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and other project management tools.

4. Understanding Australian Compliance Regulations

Compliance is critical in financial planning, particularly given the complexities of Australian financial regulations. A Financial Planning Virtual Assistant must understand these regulations and ensure that client documentation is handled correctly and securely.

Tasks might include:

  • Data entry in highly specialised crms
  • Supporti in keeping accurate client records
  • Documenting all interactions for compliance purposes
  • Assist in preparation for audits or regulatory reviews

With 17,605 businesses operating in Australia’s Financial Planning and Investment Advice sector, staying compliant is critical to staying competitive. Our professional and highly skilled talents at Virtual Office Angels can help you manage compliance tasks and align your business with legal and regulatory standards.

5. Communication Skills

Excellent communication is crucial for any remote professional, especially in the financial industry. Your virtual assistant will often act as the first point of contact for clients, manage emails, and relay information to clients and team members.

An assistant with solid communication skills can maintain client relationships and ensure your operations run smoothly.

When hiring, make sure they have:

  • Clear and professional writing skills
  • Strong verbal communication abilities
  • Confidence in handling client inquiries and managing relationships

6. Data Security and Confidentiality

Handling sensitive financial information is part of the job. Your virtual assistant should be fully aware of data protection protocols and ensure all client information is stored securely and compliant with Australia’s data protection laws.

Look for someone who understands the importance of data privacy and has experience managing confidential client records. At Virtual Office Angels, we take data security seriously. Our virtual assistants adhere to strict confidentiality standards, giving you peace of mind.

7. Organisational Skills

Assisting in managing client portfolios, organising meetings, and keeping financial data up-to-date requires a VA with excellent organisational skills. A financial planner’s assistant must juggle multiple tasks while ensuring that deadlines are met and client data is highly accurate.

They should have:

  • Strong time-management abilities
  • The ability to handle multiple client files simultaneously
  • A proactive approach to managing your calendar and appointments
  • Great attention to details
